title: Require Domain Ops Registry Surface
forbids: domain ops/index.ts registries doing anything other than importing the singular ./contract.js registry and operation entrypoints, then assembling the default implementation registry
why: The module operation registry binds the singular default authority declared by ops/contract.ts to operation implementations. Helper constants, reusable policy, contract schemas, data, source-forwarded details, and convenience operation exports must move to their owning files or be consumed through the module ops object.
remediate: Derive Contracts from typeof import("./contract.js").default and keep ops/index.ts to implementation imports, the implementations registry, and the default export. Move reusable helpers to model owners, keep operation-local internals in operation-local files, and consume operations through the module ops object.
message: Domain ops/index.ts must be the implementation registry only.
